guard: a refused detached start leaves the mesh root exactly as it found it, with no manager log and no leaked descriptor
why: The #1629 guard is only half a guard if it runs after the side effects. `startManagerDetached`
opened `manager.<key>.log` before it built the argv, so a refusal created that log and leaked
its descriptor into every fixture root that reached the call. Ordering is the whole content of
this fixture: the mutant forks nothing and still fails, which is the point.
NOT MUTATED HERE, deliberately: removing the guard itself. This suite is the one whose entry is
not the cotal entry, so a run with the guard gone re-execs the suite as its own manager and each
generation spawns the next. That mutant is graded on `install.smoke.ts` instead, where the argv
`afterRestore` rebuilds the CLI: the command builds `cotal-ai...` with the mutant in place, and
restoring the source does not restore `implementations/cli/dist`, which is gitignored.
